review_target.method: read-only inspection of immutable Git objects

logic_errors.title: New node-inspector tablist has no keyboard tab navigation
logic_errors.evidence: The controls are exposed as role=tab inside role=tablist, but have neither an onKeyDown handler for ArrowLeft/ArrowRight/Home/End nor roving tabIndex. The newly added sections therefore present tab semantics without the corresponding keyboard interaction.
reproduction: Open Canvas and select a node.
Expected: focus and selected panel move among Obsah, Zadání and Práce.
Actual: no tab selection/focus change; only pointer activation or repeated Tab can switch panels.
logic_errors.impact: Keyboard and assistive-technology users cannot operate the newly redesigned inspector as the announced tab control. The added clean-workspace E2E coverage exercises clicks only, so it does not detect this regression.

summary: Fail: one concrete P1 keyboard-accessibility regression in the newly introduced NodePanel tab control; no security concern found in the reviewed frontend scope.
